candidate_inference: restricted-null beta-binomial nuisance fit plus plug-in parametric Monte Carlo tail test

simulation.selected_scenarios: hardest/worst cases from the exact-matched 3000-repetition stress plus small-cluster checks

decision_gate: If no generator/scenario shows a clear anti-conservative signal relative to its nominal one-sided alpha, freeze the inference/design architecture and proceed immediately to the full cluster power/type-I grid. Do not continue exploratory method hunting.
